description: Controlled vocabulary defining fly ash class designations used in the material_batches tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

entries.definition: Low-calcium fly ash classified according to ASTM C618, typically produced from anthracite or bituminous coal and characterized primarily by pozzolanic behavior.
High-calcium fly ash classified according to ASTM C618, typically produced from lignite or subbituminous coal and characterized by pozzolanic and, in some cases, cementitious behavior.
Fly ash conforming to EN 450 terminology and consisting predominantly of reactive silica and alumina.
Fly ash conforming to EN 450 terminology and containing a significant proportion of reactive calcium oxide.
Fly ash class that does not fall within the predefined categories.
Fly ash class not reported or not identifiable from the available documentation.
